focus_areas: Physical connectivity of wire loops to beads
Realism of metal patina and oxidation textures
Edge sharpness between subject and white background
custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the 'fusion' severity at connection points. Real jewelry often has soldered joints which can look messy, but AI often fails to render the *hole* through a bead. Check if the topology auditor finds actual holes or just surface color changes. Also, evaluate if the 'patina' looks like chemical oxidation or just green noise painted on metal.
image_description: A close-up studio shot of an elaborate, vintage-style statement necklace against a plain white background. The necklace features a bib design with multiple irregular, organic-shaped pendants that appear to be made of textured metal (possibly brass or bronze) with green patina/verdigris and embedded colorful gemstones (red, blue, yellow, purple). The pendants are connected by smaller beads and wirework. The top corners show parts of the chain or strap mechanism.
